A nuclide of phosphorus is represented by the symbol . Which of the following correctly identifies the number of protons, neutrons, and electrons in the ion ?

  1. 15 protons, 16 neutrons, 12 electrons

  3. 15 protons, 31 neutrons, 18 electrons
